docs.title: SuperBench: High-Resolution Physics Simulations for Benchmarking SciML
docs.text:
SuperBench is a curated benchmark suite of high-resolution physics simulations built for computational science and the AI4Science community. SuperBench can be used to pre-train, fine-tune, and stress-test scientific ML models under controlled, repeatable conditions, so results are straightforward to compare and reproduce.

  • Curated, high-resolution physics simulations
  • Pre-training, fine-tuning, and stress-testing under controlled, repeatable conditions
  • Straightforward comparison and reproducibility of results
